title: TX machines
author: hugz202 (AE-analog-rytm-mods); MKII port: Iced-Cream
description: The Machinedrum's TX-9 kick and snare as machines on the analog voices. BD TX-9 on the BD track (LEV PTC DEC TUN DPT ACC WAV ATK) runs BD CLASSIC with the TX-9's pitch sweep, hold, decay and accent computed every audio block, plus the TX-9's click. SD TX-9 on the SD track (LEV PTC DEC TON SNP ACC BND DTU) runs SD CLASSIC with the TX-9's pitch, bend, detune and decay, plus the TX-9's own noise ported from the plugin. They sit in the hidden machine slots 36 and 37 through core-ar2 0.5's machine table, and their knobs are those slots' parameter records, so a sound stores them as any machine's; a kit naming them loads on a build without the mod with that track set to DISABLE. The other five machines of the MK1 mod (BD TX-9 DIGI, SD TX-8, XT TX-9, XT TX-8, BT TX-8) are not ported yet. Port of AE-analog-rytm-mods 0009-tx-machines (Analog Rytm MK1).
